title: Pay the construction industry training levy
what: As the owner of a construction project, pay the construction industry training levy before building approval is given (or before work starts, if none is needed).

sources.title: Construction Industry Training Fund Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The project owner in respect of any building or construction work is liable to pay the levy on that building or construction work

sources.title: Construction Industry Training Fund Act 1993 (SA)
